shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' package.json && rg -n 'ajv|version|CHANGELOG' package-lock.json package.json CHANGELOG.md | head -80 && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts scripts/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/hal-engine\" src scripts | head -80 && git log -3 --oneline && sed -n '1,70p' CHANGELOG.md && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && ls scripts/*reanchor* 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60; rg -n \"@spec|spec anchor|VALIDATED_BY\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"export.*ValidateFunction|interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject|class Ajv\" node_modules/ajv/dist node_modules/ajv/lib | head -30 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Compile static tool schemas at registration" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
